text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While taking a break in the cafeteria――

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are! Perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru came pitter-pattering 
running over.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~. Is there something troubling you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! Don't say that, even the smallest 
detail would help a ton!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I received a divine message from Lady 
Shiraoki saying, 'Be kind to others' 
...you see.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The prophecy is absolute! So please, let 
me do something!
choice_data_list: How about trying to be kind to yourself?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Understood-! Please sit back and relax-!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru brought over drinks and 
snacks one after another.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Next, I'll give you a shoulder massage. 
Um, after that, I'll clean the room...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Should you require anything else, please 
do not hesitate to command me as you see 
fit, Master—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Should you require anything else, please 
do not hesitate to command me, Milady—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really? Before I even realized it, 
my manners became as polished as a proper 
maid's...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This is surely the divine blessing of Lady 
Shiraoki!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wow! I never thought of looking at it that 
way. But what should we do 
specifically...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm... A Labor Thanksgiving kind of 
thing, I suppose. Well then, let's take a 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Still, is it really okay? Are you sure 
it's alright not to train?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's right! Lady Shiraoki's divine 
revelations are never wrong!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Um, if you don't mind, would it be alright 
if I joined you like this? Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I enjoyed a brief tea break with 
Matikanefukukitaru.
